purpose: Unify the outer polar Mandala domain and central rose domain without forcing either topology into the other, while defining the exact gate required before Atomic-Kode identity, Pixel projection or IsoPixel projection.

bridgeRule.principle: Outer and central domains are joined only by observed/measured adjacency, containment, path or projection relations. Sector rays MUST NOT be extended through the rose merely to manufacture central cells.

fieldIdentity.rule: An MF/CR-MF becomes eligible for stable AK assignment only after its geometry and topology are supported and G4 opens. AK numbering must not encode accidental raster coordinates.

glyphFoundation.pathSemantics: ORDERED_PATH preserves traversal order; identical AK sets may define distinct structures when traversal or relations differ.
glyphFoundation.renderingRule: Glyph geometry is generated from Mandala-addressed structure. It is not reverse-engineered from arbitrary drawn pixels.

pixel.rule: Every structural pixel must map to one or more AKs through a versioned projection.

isopixel.rule: Every structural isopixel is a deterministic spatial projection of Mandala-addressed structure, never independent artwork.

voxel.rule: Depth/extrusion must be generated by a declared versioned rule and preserve AK provenance.

nextParallelGates.task: Classify all 288 conditional outer addresses as SUPPORTED, PARTIAL, REFUTED or UNRESOLVED from boundary continuity evidence.
Independently segment the central rose and test whether three layers with cardinalities 3, 7 and 12 are geometrically supported.

requirements: Outer field census has evidence-classified fields and stable adjacency rules.
Central rose census has evidence-classified cells and stable adjacency rules.
Bridge relations between outer and central domains are measured or remain explicitly unresolved.
No cardinality has been target-fitted to 441 or 22.
All future Pixel/IsoPixel schemas reference field/AK provenance rather than visual coordinates as identity.
convergenceGate.result: Open stable Atomic-Kode assignment and topology graph construction.
